title: Detailed snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Snow ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#cfe8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='20' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#a8c8e8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='16' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#b0d0f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Head snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='12' fill='#f8fcff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#b8d8f8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='35' y='16' width='30' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <rect x='35' y='16' width='30' height='5' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Hat top -->
  <rect x='39' y='4' width='22' height='13' rx='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <rect x='39' y='4' width='22' height='13' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x='39' y='13' width='22' height='3' fill='#e84040'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='26' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='26' r='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='26' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='25.2' r='0.7' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='25.2' r='0.7' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <!-- Carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,29 63,31.5 50,33' fill='#ff8020'/>
  <polygon points='50,29 63,31.5 50,33' fill='none' stroke='#ffb060' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile of coal dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='46.5' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37.8' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <!-- Scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M34 38 Q50 44 66 38 L66 43 Q50 49 34 43 Z' fill='#e84040'/>
  <path d='M34 38 Q50 44 66 38 L66 43 Q50 49 34 43 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail -->
  <path d='M62 42 Q68 48 66 58 L60 56 Q62 48 58 44 Z' fill='#e84040'/>
  <path d='M62 42 Q68 48 66 58 L60 56 Q62 48 58 44 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Scarf fringe -->
  <line x1='61' y1='58' x2='60' y2='61' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='58' x2='62' y2='61' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='57.5' x2='64.5' y2='60.5' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Middle buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- Bottom buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='2' fill='#2a2a50'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='2' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- Left stick arm -->
  <line x1='34' y1='46' x2='18' y2='36' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='36' x2='14' y2='30' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='36' x2='13' y2='38' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='38' x2='20' y2='31' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right stick arm -->
  <line x1='66' y1='46' x2='82' y2='36' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='36' x2='86' y2='30' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='36' x2='87' y2='38' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='38' x2='80' y2='31' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Small snowflakes around -->
  <g fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'>
    <circle cx='15' cy='15' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='20' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='10' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='8' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='55' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='60' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='72' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='78' r='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
